import sys
import numpy as np
import networkx as nx
import dimod
import pennylane as qml
from pennylane import QubitOperator, expval, Devices, qft, reset
from qiskit import QuantumCircuit, execute, Aer, transpile
from qiskit.visualization import plot_bloch_multivector
from qiskit.circuit.library import QFT
from qiskit_algorithms import QuantumApproximateOptimizationAlgorithm
from qiskit_algorithms.optimizers import COBYLA

def solve_mis_qaoa(graph_vertices, graph_edges, optimal_independent_set_size, p_layers=3, penalty=2.0, opt_shots=2048, final_shots=4096, maxiter=150, seed=42):

    # Create graph and find maximum independent set
    G = nx.Graph()
    G.add_nodes_from(graph_vertices)
    G.add_edges_from(graph_edges)
    max_independent_set = list(nx.maximal_independent_set(G))
    assert len(max_independent_set) == optimal_independent_set_size

    # Create Qiskit graph and find number of blockade-pair edges
    qc = QuantumCircuit(len(graph_vertices), len(graph_edges))
    for edge in graph_edges:
        qc.cx(edge[0], edge[1])
    n_blockade_pairs = qc.count_ops(QuantumGate('cx'))

    # Define QAOA parameters and construct Hamiltonian
    p_list = [dimod.BinaryVariable(i) for i in range(p_layers * len(graph_vertices))]
    qaoa_hamiltonian = QubitOperator([[penalty * (1 - 2 * qc.q[i].p for i in range(len(graph_vertices))), -qc.cx(i, j) for (i, j) in enumerate(graph_edges)] + [-qc.ry(p_list[p_layers*i]) for i in range(len(graph_vertices))], coeffs=[1] + [-1] * n_blockade_pairs)

    # Define Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm (QAOA)
    qaoa = QuantumApproximateOptimizationAlgorithm(qaoa_hamiltonian, p_list, COBYLA(maxiter=maxiter), seed_initial_point=dimod.sample_qubo_uniform_starting_point(qaoa_hamiltonian.qubo, len(p_list), num_samples=1, seed=seed))

    # Run QAOA and obtain results
    qaoa.initialize(qc)
    opt_samples = qaoa.sample(opt_shots)
    final_samples = qaoa.sample(final_shots)

    # Calculate independent set ratio, validity rate, embedding overhead, and resource cost
    independent_set_ratio = np.mean([1 if np.all(qc.q[i].data[0] == 0 for i in max_independent_set) else 0 for p in opt_samples.samples for i in range(len(graph_vertices))])
    validity_rate = np.mean([qc.validate_statevector(state) for state in final_samples.samples])
    embedding_overhead = n_blockade_pairs / (len(graph_edges) * len(graph_vertices) / 2)
    resource_cost = n_blockade_pairs * (2 * p_layers + 1) + len(graph_edges) * 2 + 3 * len(graph_vertices)

    return {'independent_set_ratio': independent_set_ratio, 'validity_rate': validity_rate, 'embedding_overhead': embedding_overhead, 'resource_cost': resource_cost}

import dimod
import pennylane as qml
from pennylane import QubitOperator, expval, Devices, qft, reset

    assert len(max_independent_set) == optimal_independent_set_size

    # Create Qiskit graph and find number of blockade-pair edges
    qc = QuantumCircuit(len(graph_vertices), len(graph_edges))
    for edge in graph_edges:
        qc.cx(edge[0], edge[1])
    n_blockade_pairs = qc.count_ops(QuantumGate('cx'))

    # Define QAOA parameters and construct Hamiltonian
    p_list = [dimod.BinaryVariable(i) for i in range(p_layers * len(graph_vertices))]
    qaoa_hamiltonian = QubitOperator([[penalty * (1 - 2 * qc.q[i].p for i in range(len(graph_vertices))), -qc.cx(i, j) for (i, j) in enumerate(graph_edges)] + [-qc.ry(p_list[p_layers*i]) for i in range(len(graph_vertices))], coeffs=[1] + [-1] * n_blockade_pairs)

    # Define Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm (QAOA)

    # Run QAOA and obtain results
    qaoa.initialize(qc)
    opt_samples = qaoa.sample(opt_shots)
    final_samples = qaoa.sample(final_shots)

    # Calculate independent set ratio, validity rate, embedding overhead, and resource cost
    independent_set_ratio = np.mean([1 if np.all(qc.q[i].data[0] == 0 for i in max_independent_set) else 0 for p in opt_samples.samples for i in range(len(graph_vertices))])
    validity_rate = np.mean([qc.validate_statevector(state) for state in final_samples.samples])
    embedding_overhead = n_blockade_pairs / (len(graph_edges) * len(graph_vertices) / 2)
    resource_cost = n_blockade_pairs * (2 * p_layers + 1) + len(graph_edges) * 2 + 3 * len(graph_vertices)

    return {'independent_set_ratio': independent_set_ratio, 'validity_rate': validity_rate, 'embedding_overhead': embedding_overhead, 'resource_cost': resource_cost}

# Sample graph for testing
